caption: The image is a monochromatic drawing of an ornate metal door knocker rendered in shades of gray, giving a realistic, three-dimensional appearance. The knocker has a symmetrical design featuring elaborate, curving motifs with acanthus leaf patterns and scrollwork. It consists of a large, rounded handle with intricate, raised decorations that is hinged at the top to a detailed backplate. The backplate at the top has a fan-shaped, leaf-like motif, and the handle arches downward, ending in another flourish that mirrors the decorative style. The background is plain and light in color, and at the bottom left corner, the name "Julius Bellamy" is written in small text. There are some minor orange-brown spots on the background paper.
title: Door Knocker
